# TalkOps (`talkops-ai/talkops`) — Complete LLM & AI Agent Technical Reference

> Open-source multi-agent AI platform for DevOps, SRE, Cloud, and Platform Engineering—operating across an interactive Terminal UI (`talkops` / `ops`), headless CI/CD pipelines (`talkops -p ... --rubric`), two-way ChatOps (`Slack`, `Microsoft Teams`, `Discord`), and 24/7 autonomous incident webhooks (`talkops serve`) while keeping cloud credentials local.

- **Repository:** https://github.com/talkops-ai/talkops
- **PyPI Package:** `talkops-ai` (installs both `talkops` and `ops` CLI binaries; requires Python `>=3.12`)
- **License:** Apache-2.0
- **Core Stack:** Python 3.12+, LangGraph, LangChain DeepAgents, Textual TUI, Stagehand (Chrome automation), QuickJS (`js_eval` code-mode subagent orchestration), and TypeSafe AI Jev System-1 safety/routing engine.
- **Index Map:** See [llms.txt](llms.txt) for the concise `llmstxt.org` documentation index.

---

## 1. Executive Architecture & Category Positioning

### What Problem TalkOps Solves
Platform engineers, SREs, and CloudOps teams spend hours triaging 3 AM alert storms (PagerDuty, Prometheus Alertmanager, Datadog, CloudWatch), debugging Kubernetes failures (`CrashLoopBackOff`, `OOMKilled`, ingress/mesh latency), auditing multi-region cloud waste across AWS, Azure, and GCP, and reviewing Terraform/OpenTofu/Helm Pull Requests for IAM or FinOps regressions. Existing tools either perform narrow static checks or require uploading sensitive production cloud credentials to external SaaS platforms.

TalkOps runs locally on an engineer's workstation or self-hosted inside your VPC/cluster using your native CLI credential chains (`~/.aws`, `~/.kube/config`, `az`, `gcloud`, `@ambient` IAM roles, `@in-cluster` service accounts). It enforces `--read-only` boundaries, `<100ms` zero-token Jev System-1 blast-radius checks, and deterministic `--rubric` verification before completing work.

### Comparison: TalkOps vs. K8sGPT vs. Infracost vs. Generic Coding Agents

| Dimension | TalkOps (`talkops-ai/talkops`) | K8sGPT (`k8sgpt-ai/k8sgpt`) | Infracost (`infracost/infracost`) | Generic Terminal Coding Agents |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Core Scope** | End-to-end AI SRE, CloudOps, FinOps, IaC/GitOps coding, Browser UI automation, CI/CD rubrics & 24/7 Webhook RCA | Kubernetes error explanations (`k8sgpt analyze --explain`) | Static Terraform/IaC cost diffing in Pull Requests | General software engineering & repository editing |
| **Multi-Cloud & K8s Context** | Built-in Credential Broker (`/cloud`, `/aws`, `/azure`, `/gcp`, `/k8s`) with live profile, role, project & cluster switching | Kubernetes-only (`kubeconfig` / in-cluster) | Static HCL plan/manifest parsing | Relies on ambient shell environment without cloud context broker |
| **Autonomous Incident Webhooks** | `talkops serve` ingests 9+ alert sources, deduplicates alert storms, dispatches isolated plugin subagents, and writes RCAs back to tickets & chat | In-cluster operator emits K8s CRDs; no ITSM/ChatOps war-room orchestration | Not an incident response runtime | No built-in webhook server, storm drain, or two-way ChatOps |
| **CI/CD PR Rubric Gate** | Native `--rubric` grading loop + composite GitHub Action (`action.yml`) for custom security, IAM & FinOps policies | No PR rubric loop | FinOps policy comments on IaC diffs | Prompt-only PR comments without iterative rubric verification |
| **Browser UI Automation** | Built-in Stagehand `browser` subagent (`/browser`) reusing live Chrome SSO (`DevToolsActivePort`) with DevOps/SRE dashboard playbooks | None | None | Requires external browser setup without DevOps blast-radius gates |
| **Safety & Blast-Radius Control** | `--read-only`, `<100ms` zero-token System-1 safety gate, `PreToolUse` hooks with secret stripping, and terminal/chat HITL cards | Read-only cluster analyzers | Read-only IaC parsing | Manual per-command prompts or static allowlists |
| **Model Agnosticism** | 26+ providers: Local Ollama, Anthropic, OpenAI/Codex, Gemini/Vertex AI, Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Groq, DeepSeek, custom `--base-url` | Subset of LLM backends | Pricing API | Often coupled to a single model vendor |

---

## 2. Installation, Authentication & Privacy Model

### Installation
```bash
# macOS, Linux, or Windows WSL2 (provisions Python 3.12+, uv, and ripgrep automatically; do NOT use sudo)
curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talkops-ai/talkops/main/scripts/install.sh | bash

# Windows PowerShell (native — no WSL required)
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talkops-ai/talkops/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex

# Package managers (Python 3.12+)
uv tool install --python 3.12 talkops-ai
pipx install talkops-ai
pip install -U talkops-ai
```

### Authentication & Zero-Exfiltration Guarantee
```bash
# 1. Free lightweight Control Plane sign-in (or pass TALKOPS_API_KEY="oc_live_..." in CI/CD)
talkops auth login --sso

# 2. Configure any LLM provider (saved to OS Keyring + ~/.talkops/.env with 0600 permissions)
talkops auth set anthropic                # prompts securely if key omitted
talkops auth set openai --base-url https://llm.internal.example.com/v1
talkops -M ollama:qwen3:8b                # 100% local inference via Ollama

# 3. Optional: Enable TypeSafe AI Jev Smart Mode (<70ms routing + <100ms System-1 safety gate)
talkops auth set typesafe ts-...

# 4. Verify cloud STS identity, configured providers, and local DevOps CLIs
talkops auth status
talkops doctor
```
- **Local Credential Privacy:** TalkOps never uploads `~/.aws/credentials`, `~/.kube/config`, Azure/GCP tokens, source code, or LLM API keys to TalkOps servers. All CLI/SDK operations execute locally (or in your own configured sandbox/server).

---

## 3. Four Unified Execution Modes

### Mode 1: Interactive Terminal UI (`talkops` / `ops`)
Rich Textual TUI featuring live cloud/Kubernetes status bar, `/` fuzzy command palette, `!shell` inline execution, `@file` context attachment, live `dynamic subagents` telemetry panel, and unified diff/approval modals.
```bash
talkops --read-only
talkops --smart -M anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-5
talkops --aws-profile prod-readonly --aws-region ap-south-1 -m "Check EKS node readiness and failing pods"
talkops -a aws-finops-engineer
```

### Mode 2: Headless CLI & CI/CD Pipelines (`talkops -p`)
Single-turn or multi-turn non-interactive execution for shell scripts, cron jobs, GitHub Actions, and GitLab CI.
- Exit codes: `0` (success / all rubric criteria passed), `2` (rubric criteria unmet), `124` (`--timeout` exceeded), `1` (execution/config error).
```bash
# Enforce security & FinOps acceptance criteria in CI/CD
talkops -p "Audit ./infra Terraform modules and k8s/ manifests for IAM wildcards and missing resource limits" \
  --read-only \
  --max-turns 12 \
  --rubric @examples/rubrics/k8s-security-rubric.md

# Pipe live cluster logs into headless RCA with JSON output
kubectl logs deploy/payment-api -n prod --tail=200 \
  | talkops -p "Identify the proximate trigger and root cause of the 502 spike" --json -q
```

### Mode 3: Central Server & Shared Team Runtime (`talkops serve`)
Turns TalkOps into a multi-user server backed by SQLite (`~/.talkops/sessions.db` default) or PostgreSQL (`--postgres-uri` / `TALKOPS_POSTGRES_URI`).
```bash
# Launch Central Server (default port 2024)
talkops serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 2024 --profile sre

# Connect from any remote developer or SRE workstation
talkops auth login --server-url http://talkops.internal:2024 --api-key oc_live_... --user-id alice
talkops --server-url http://talkops.internal:2024
talkops -r <thread_id>   # Resume or inspect a shared incident thread (use /fork in TUI to branch safely)
```

### Mode 4: Autonomous Webhook Incident Triage (`POST /webhooks/{provider}`)
Ingests real-time alerts from monitoring, ITSM, and CI/CD platforms, filters `"OK"`/`"Resolved"` noise, deduplicates alert storms into a single canonical incident thread, runs SRE root-cause investigation, posts two-stage incident cards to Slack/Teams/Discord, and writes structured RCAs back to PagerDuty, ServiceNow, and GitHub.

---

## 4. Complete CLI & In-Chat Slash Command Reference

### Primary `talkops` (`ops`) CLI Flags

| Flag | Alias | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `--prompt <text>` | `-p`, `-n` | Run headlessly in non-interactive mode, print output, and exit. |
| `--message <text>` | `-m` | Launch interactive TUI and immediately submit `<text>` as the first turn. |
| `--smart` | — | Enable Jev Smart Mode (dynamic 3-tier model routing + System-1 safety gate). |
| `--approval-mode <mode>` | — | Set approval policy: `manual`, `smart`, `auto`, or `yolo` (`yolo` restricted to `-p` and `serve`). |
| `--auto-approve` | `-y` | Auto-approve routine operations while still gating destructive actions. |
| `--read-only` | `--dry-run` | Enforce read-only cloud, Kubernetes, and shell guardrails (blocks mutations). |
| `--model <spec>` | `-M` | Select `provider:model` (e.g., `anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-5`, `google_vertexai:gemini-3.8-flash`, `ollama:llama3.3`). |
| `--default-model [spec]` | — | Show or persist default model in `~/.talkops/config.toml` (`--clear-default-model` resets). |
| `--model-params <json>` | — | Pass JSON constructor overrides (e.g., `'{"temperature": 0.0}'`). |
| `--agent <name>` | `-a` | Start directly inside specialist subagent `<name>` (`Persona Mode`). |
| `--no-subagents` | — | Disable subagent delegation and run strictly in single-agent mode. |
| `--skill <name>` | `-s` | Pre-load and activate `SKILL.md` playbook `<name>` at startup. |
| `--goal <objective>` | — | Launch session with a tracked multi-step goal. |
| `--rubric <text\|@file>` | — | Acceptance checklist verified before `-p` completes (`--rubric-model`, `--rubric-max-iterations`). |
| `--aws-profile <name>` | — | Scope session to AWS profile `<name>` without mutating global shell state. |
| `--aws-region <region>` | — | Scope session to AWS region `<region>`. |
| `--sandbox [provider]` | — | Execute tools in isolated cloud sandbox (`modal`, `daytona`, `runloop`, `langsmith`, `agentcore`, `vercel`). |
| `--sandbox-id <id>` | — | Attach to an existing sandbox (`--sandbox-snapshot-name`, `--sandbox-setup <script.sh>`). |
| `--server-url <url>` | — | Attach CLI/TUI to a remote `talkops serve` instance (`--api-key`, `--user-id`). |
| `--resume <thread_id>` | `-r` | Resume local or remote conversation thread `<thread_id>`. |
| `--cwd <path>` | `--workspace` | Set target project/workspace directory. |
| `--mcp-config <path>` | — | Load additional `.mcp.json` (`--no-mcp` disables MCP; `--trust-project-mcp` auto-trusts repo MCP). |
| `--shell-allow-list <list>` | `-S` | Comma-separated shell command allowlist (`recommended`, `all`, or explicit binaries). |
| `--tnr` | — | Enable Transactional Non-Regression verification & automatic rollback checks. |
| `--json` | `--output-format json` | Emit structured JSON output in headless `-p` mode (`-q`/`--quiet`, `--no-stream`, `--stdin`). |
| `--max-turns <int>` | — | Cap maximum agent turns in `-p` mode (`--timeout <sec>` enforces wall-clock limit). |
| `--trajectory-file <path>` | — | Export full execution trajectory as JSONL (`-V`/`--verbose`, `--log-level`, `--log-file`). |

### CLI Subcommands

| Subcommand | Key Actions & Flags | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `talkops serve` *(aliases: `webhook`, `webhooks`)* | `[start]`, `list`, `addons`, `--port 2024`, `--webhook-port`, `--profile {default,api-only,webhook-worker,sre,enterprise-full}`, `--postgres-uri`, `--approval-mode`, `--read-only` | Run Central Server, Addon Microkernel, ChatOps hub, and webhook listener. |
| `talkops auth` | `login [--sso] [--server-url] [--api-key]`, `logout`, `status`, `set <provider> [key] [--base-url]`, `list`, `remove`, `aws`, `token` | Manage Control Plane/Server auth, 26+ LLM provider keys, and AWS STS checks. |
| `talkops openwiki` *(alias: `wiki`)* | `status [--json]`, `init [--force] [--brief]`, `update`, `ask "<query>" [--json]`, `brief "<rule>"`, `link` | Deterministically compile, update, drift-check, and BM25-search `openwiki/`. |
| `talkops plugin` *(alias: `plugins`)* | `list`, `search <kw>`, `install <name> [--scope {user,project,local}]`, `uninstall`, `enable`, `disable`, `refresh`, `marketplace {list,add,remove,refresh}` | Manage DevOps plugins and marketplaces (`talkops-ai/devops-plugins` or custom Git repos). |
| `talkops addon` *(alias: `addons`)* | `list`, `search <kw>`, `install <name> [--scope] [--no-deps]`, `uninstall`, `enable`, `disable`, `refresh`, `marketplace {list,add,remove}` | Manage Central Server addons (`talkops-ai/talkops-addons`). |
| `talkops skills` *(alias: `skill`)* | `list [--project]`, `create <name> [--project]`, `info <name>`, `delete <name>`, `trust` | Scaffold, inspect, and manage `SKILL.md` operational playbooks. |
| `talkops agents` *(alias: `agent`)* | `list [--json]` | Inspect all discovered project, plugin, and personal specialist subagents. |
| `talkops mcp` | `list`, `status`, `probe` | Validate and live-probe configured `stdio`, `http`, and `sse` MCP servers. |
| `talkops threads` | `list [--server-url] [--user-id]`, `delete <thread_id>` | List or prune saved local/remote conversation threads. |
| `talkops doctor` | `talkops doctor` | Verify Python environment, cloud STS credentials, and DevOps CLIs (`aws`, `kubectl`, `terraform`, `helm`, `docker`, `git`). |
| `talkops benchmark` | `run --suite <name>` | Execute automated SRE/DevOps evaluation benchmarks (e.g., `sregym`). |

### Interactive TUI Shortcuts & `/slash` Commands

- **Input Prefixes & Keys:** `/` (command palette), `!<cmd>` (direct local shell execution), `@<path>` (attach file), `Shift+Tab` (cycle `Manual` $\rightarrow$ `Smart` $\rightarrow$ `Auto`), `Ctrl+O` (expand/collapse tool & subagent telemetry), `Ctrl+X` (open `$EDITOR`), `Esc` (interrupt active turn).
- **Approval & Routing:** `/smart`, `/auto`, `/manual`, `/permissions`, `/model [<provider:model>] [--default]`, `/pool`, `/effort [low|medium|high|max|off]`, `/fast`.
- **Cloud, Goals & Code Quality:** `/cloud` (aliases: `/aws`, `/azure`, `/gcp`, `/k8s`), `/goal [<objective>|pause|resume|clear]`, `/rubric [set <text>]`, `/review`, `/doctor`, `/trace`.
- **Subagents, Browser & Knowledge:** `/agent [<name>|show|detach|attach|clear]`, `/browser [<task>|status|mode <mode>|disconnect]` (alias `/web`), `/openwiki [status|init|update|ask|brief|link]` (alias `/wiki`), `/skills`, `/skill:<name>`, `/skill-creator`, `/memory` (alias `/remember`), `/plugins`, `/mcp`, `/tools`.
- **Session & Context Control:** `/compact`, `/fork`, `/new` (`/clear`), `/resume`, `/btw <side-question>` (tool-free single-turn side question without polluting thread state), `/config`, `/reload`.

---

## 5. Approval Modes, Jev Smart Mode & Production Guardrails

### Four Approval Modes
1. **`manual`**: Prompts operator (`Approve`, `Reject`, `Edit args`, `Switch mode`) before shell execution, file writes, or mutating MCP calls.
2. **`smart`** (`--smart` / `/smart`): Activates TypeSafe AI Jev System-1 classification:
   - **3-Tier Model Pool Routing (`<70ms`)**: Routes simple status lookups to **Fast** (`effort="off"`), standard engineering turns to **Standard**, and complex multi-signal RCA or plugin-subagent orchestration to **Powerful**—reducing token costs by 80–90%.
   - **Zero-Token Tool Safety Gate (`<100ms`)**: Classifies every proposed shell command, file write, and MCP tool call for state mutation and blast radius using zero LLM tokens. Safe read-only checks execute automatically; mutating/destructive operations pause fail-closed for human approval.
3. **`auto`** (`--auto-approve` / `/auto`): Auto-runs standard read/write workflows while still gating high-blast-radius destructive patterns and honoring `--read-only`.
4. **`yolo`**: Unattended execution strictly limited to headless CLI (`-p`) and `talkops serve` inside controlled sandboxes or automation pipelines (still blocked from mutating if `--read-only` is set).

---

## 6. Specialist Subagents, Code-Mode (`js_eval`) & Plugin Architecture

### Built-In vs. Plugin Subagent Delegation Contract
TalkOps keeps noisy domain exploration out of the main orchestrator's context window using two distinct delegation paths:

1. **Built-In Subagents (`task` tool)**:
   - `general-purpose`: Multi-step repository research, file search, and background analysis.
   - `browser`: Isolated Chrome/Stagehand web & dashboard automation subagent.
   - Invoked directly via `task(subagent_type="browser", description="...")` or `task(subagent_type="general-purpose", description="...")`.
2. **Plugin & Extension Subagents (`js_eval` QuickJS Code Interpreter ONLY)**:
   - Installed plugin subagents (such as `kubernetes-observability-engineer`, `kubernetes-delivery-engineer`, `aws-sre-agent`, `aws-finops-engineer`, `aws-cloud-security-engineer` from `talkops-ai/devops-plugins`) bundle **isolated MCP servers** (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Loki, Tempo, Argo CD, Helm, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, IAM, Cost Explorer) and scoped `SKILL.md` playbooks that are **never** attached to the main agent.
   - The main orchestrator dispatches plugin subagents via the sandboxed QuickJS `js_eval` tool (`await task({ description: "...", subagentType: "<plugin-subagent>" })`, or `await Promise.all([...])` for parallel multi-domain fan-out, ending with a bare JavaScript expression rather than top-level `return`).
3. **Direct 1-on-1 Specialist Persona Mode (`/agent <name>` or `talkops -a <name>`)**:
   - Routes user prompts straight to the chosen specialist with its isolated MCP servers and skills. Supports `/agent detach`, `/agent attach`, and `/agent clear` (which synthesizes an automatic **Handoff Summary** back into the main thread).

### Custom Markdown Subagents (`.talkops/agents/<name>.md`)
Define zero-code team specialists using YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`, `model`, `mode: isolated|fork`, `skills`, `tools`, `capabilities`, `permission_tier`, `mcp_files`, `mcp_config`) or connect remote LangGraph graphs under `[async_subagents.<name>]` in `config.toml`.

### Official Plugin & MCP Ecosystem
- **`talkops-ai/devops-plugins` (`talkops-devops-plugins`)**:
  - **20 Specialist Agent Plugins**: `aws-agentcore-engineer`, `aws-amplify-engineer`, `aws-cloud-security-engineer`, `aws-data-engineer`, `aws-database-engineer`, `aws-deployment-engineer`, `aws-devsecops-engineer`, `aws-eks-upgrade-engineer`, `aws-finops-engineer`, `aws-iac-engineer`, `aws-location-engineer`, `aws-modernization-agent`, `aws-platform-engineer`, `aws-sagemaker-engineer`, `aws-serverless-engineer`, `aws-solutions-architect`, `aws-sre-agent`, `aws-startup-advisor`, `kubernetes-delivery-engineer`, `kubernetes-observability-engineer`.
  - **21 AWS Vertical Skill Packs**: Attach domain skills and `/commands` directly to the main agent (`aws-ai-ml`, `aws-analytics`, `aws-compute`, `aws-containers`, `aws-cost-optimization`, `aws-databases`, `aws-essentials`, `aws-infrastructure-as-code`, `aws-messaging-and-streaming`, `aws-migration`, `aws-networking`, `aws-observability`, `aws-resilience`, `aws-security-identity`, `aws-serverless`, `aws-storage`, `aws-well-architected`, etc.).
  - **8 Partner-Built Plugins**: HashiCorp `terraform`, `crossplane-aws-engineer`, `elastic`, `honeycomb`, `coralogix`, `launchdarkly`, `neo4j`, `bronto`.
- **Lazy MCP Tool Dispatcher (`call_mcp_tool`)**: External and subagent MCP servers (`stdio`, `http`, `sse`) use on-demand schema hydration and connection pooling so dozens of MCP tools do not bloat prompt tokens at startup.

---

## 7. Memory (`AGENTS.md`), Skills (`SKILL.md`), OpenWiki & Custom Commands

### Persistent Memory & Progressive Skills
- **Memory**: Loads project (`AGENTS.md`, `.talkops/AGENTS.md`) and global (`~/.talkops/AGENTS.md`) instructions plus `.talkops/memory/<key>.md` notes (capped at 250 lines / 30 KB). Run `/remember` at any point to distill session learnings into `AGENTS.md` or a reusable `SKILL.md`.
- **Skills (`agentskills.io`)**: 3-stage progressive disclosure—Stage 1 loads compact YAML `name` + `description`; Stage 2 reads `SKILL.md` only when triggered; Stage 3 accesses `references/`, `scripts/`, and `assets/` on demand. Precedence: `.agents/skills/` > `.talkops/skills/` > `~/.agents/skills/` > `~/.talkops/agents/talkops/skills/` > plugin skills > built-in skills (`remember`, `skill-creator`, `commit`, `simplify`, `openwiki`).

### OpenWiki: Git-Grounded Codebase Knowledge (`openwiki/`)
Compiles a curated Open Knowledge Format v0.2 Markdown wiki inside `openwiki/` (`index.md`, `quickstart.md`, `INSTRUCTIONS.md`, `<slug>.md`) backed by SHA-256 **Grounded Claims** (`openwiki/.claims/<slug>.json` tracking `file_exists`, `file_lines`, and `symbol` anchors).
- **Zero-LLM CLI Mode:** `talkops openwiki init`, `talkops openwiki update`, `talkops openwiki status --json`, `talkops openwiki ask "<query>"`.
- **Agent-Enriched TUI Mode:** `/openwiki init`, `/openwiki update`, `/openwiki ask ...`, `/openwiki brief ...`, `/openwiki link` (safely heals `CLAUDE.md -> AGENTS.md` symlinks and maintains `<!-- OPENWIKI:START -->` blocks).
- **Runtime Discipline:** Retrieval (`openwiki_search`, `openwiki_read`) is local, read-only, BM25 + 1-hop `[[wikilink]]` graph-expanded, and just-in-time—emitting live freshness notices whenever Git `HEAD` or tracked files drift, while always treating live source code and tests as authoritative.

### Custom Slash Commands & Hooks
- **Custom Commands (`.talkops/commands/**/*.md`)**: Support `$ARGUMENTS`, `$0..$N`, named `arguments:` placeholders, `${TALKOPS_PROJECT_DIR}` / `${TALKOPS_SKILL_DIR}`, inline shell output injection (`` !`git status` `` and ```` ```! ```` fenced blocks), `allowed-tools` brace expansion (e.g., `"Bash(kubectl:{get,describe,logs} *)"`), `model`/`effort` overrides, and `context: fork`.
- **Hooks (`~/.talkops/hooks.json` & plugin `hooks/hooks.json`)**: Support JSON-over-`stdin` event audit hooks (`session.start`, `tool.use`, `terraform.apply`, `webhook.received`, `webhook.completed`) and lifecycle interception matchers (`PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `PermissionRequest`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `SubagentStart`, `Stop`). Subprocess environments automatically strip `KEY`, `TOKEN`, `SECRET`, `PASSWORD`, `APIKEY`, and `CREDENTIAL` variables before execution.

---

## 8. Browser Automation Agent (`/browser` & `/web`)

TalkOps embeds a dedicated **`browser`** subagent (`TalkOpsBrowserMiddleware`) built on Stagehand's Playwright facade:

- **4 Browser Tools** (paired with workspace `read_file`, `write_file`, `edit_file`, `ls`, `glob`, `grep`, `ask_user` — no unrestricted host `execute` shell):
  1. `snapshot(includeIframes=True)`: Reads the accessibility tree with `[frame-node]` IDs (`[0-34]`). Snapshots `>8 KB` save full text to `~/.talkops/artifacts/browser/snapshots/snapshot_full_<ts>.txt` and keep **65% head** (top nav, region/account headers, time pickers) + **35% tail** (SPA drawers, modal portals, streaming logs) in context, while automatically pruning superseded snapshots from prior turns.
  2. `run(actions=[...] | code="...")`: Executes batched semantic actions (`click`, `hover`, `fill`, `type`, `press`, `select`) or async Playwright JS (`page`, `context`, `browser`).
  3. `screenshot(fullPage, type, quality)`: Persists PNG/JPEG captures to `~/.talkops/artifacts/browser/screenshots/` and returns multimodal image blocks for `<canvas>`/`<svg>` chart, topology, and flamegraph inspection.
  4. `browser_handoff(reason, url)`: Pauses via LangGraph `interrupt()` when encountering SSO/SAML/OIDC logins, 2FA/MFA prompts, CAPTCHAs/Cloudflare Turnstile, or Chrome remote-debugging setup (`chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging`), then automatically captures a fresh snapshot on resume.
- **3-Tier Chrome Connection Cascade (`/browser mode <mode>`)**:
  - `auto` *(default)*: Tier 1 explicit CDP (`TALKOPS_BROWSER_WS_URL`) $\rightarrow$ Tier 2 live user Chrome via `DevToolsActivePort` (reuses active Okta/AWS/GCP/Grafana/Datadog SSO cookies; detaches cleanly via `disconnect()` without closing user tabs) $\rightarrow$ Tier 3 persistent profile (`~/.talkops/browser-profile`).
  - Also supports strict `auto_connect`, `persistent`, headless `isolated` (CI/CD), and remote `browserbase` cloud sessions.
- **DevOps Safety Gates**: Enforces HTTP/HTTPS + SSRF IP validation (blocking `169.254.169.254` while permitting `localhost` / `kubectl port-forward`) and automatic HITL approval prompts before clicking destructive/high-blast-radius controls (`Delete`, `Terminate`, `Destroy`, `Revoke`, `Rotate Secret`, `Invalidate Token`, `Drain Node`, `Prune Resources`, `Force Sync`, `Force Push`) or issuing JS HTTP `DELETE` requests.

---

## 9. Central Server Addons, SRE Profile & Autonomous Webhooks

### Server Profiles (`talkops serve --profile <name>`)

| Profile | Enabled Built-In Addons | Primary Use Case |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `default` | `core-auth`, `client-gateway`, `webhooks`, `channels` | All-in-one shared team server, webhook listener, and Slack/Teams/Discord ChatOps hub. |
| `api-only` | `core-auth`, `client-gateway` | Remote CLI/TUI server without inbound webhooks or ChatOps adapters. |
| `webhook-worker` | `webhooks`, `channels`, `context-graph` | Dedicated horizontally scaled alert ingestion and ChatOps notification workers. |
| `sre` | `core-auth`, `client-gateway`, `webhooks`, `channels`, `context-graph`, `intelligence` | Full autonomous SRE & Incident RCA stack with blast-radius/change correlation, hypothesis ledger tools, storm draining, and 3-Stage Stratified AutoQA. |
| `enterprise-full` | All 6 built-in addons + `.talkops/addons.json` extensions | Enterprise base profile for custom/marketplace addons and dedicated `--webhook-port` listeners. |

*(Note: SRE workflow tools—`query_service_blast_radius`, `list_recent_infrastructure_changes`, `search_incident_memory`, `record_hypothesis_verdict`, `record_operational_memory_rule`, and `artifact_query`—attach strictly on SRE/webhook server profiles and never clutter standard interactive `talkops` TUI sessions.)*

### 9 Built-In Webhook Adapters (`POST /webhooks/{provider}`)

| Provider | Canonical Endpoint | Shorthand Aliases | Automated Write-Back Targets |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **PagerDuty v3/v2** | `/webhooks/pagerduty` | `/webhooks/pd` | PagerDuty Incident Notes (`TALKOPS_WEBHOOK_PAGERDUTY_API_KEY`) + Slack / Teams / Discord |
| **Alertmanager / Grafana** | `/webhooks/alertmanager` | `/webhooks/{prometheus,grafana,mimir,loki,vmalert}` | Slack / Teams / Discord + Custom Callback URL |
| **AWS SNS / CloudWatch** | `/webhooks/sns` | `/webhooks/{cloudwatch,eventbridge,aws-sns,aws}` | Auto-confirms SNS subscriptions; posts RCA to Slack / Teams / Discord + Callback |
| **Datadog** | `/webhooks/datadog` | `/webhooks/dd` | Slack / Teams / Discord + Custom Callback URL |
| **ServiceNow ITSM** | `/webhooks/servicenow` | `/webhooks/{snow,itsm}` | ServiceNow Incident `work_notes` (`SERVICENOW_URL`, `SERVICENOW_TOKEN`) + ChatOps |
| **GitHub** | `/webhooks/github` | `/webhooks/{gh,github-actions}` | GitHub PR / Issue comments (`TALKOPS_WEBHOOK_GITHUB_TOKEN`) on failed Actions or `@talkops` mentions |
| **Jenkins** | `/webhooks/jenkins` | `/webhooks/{ci,jenkins-ci}` | Slack / Teams / Discord + Custom Callback URL |
| **CNCF CloudEvents 1.0** | `/webhooks/cloudevents` | `/webhooks/{argo-events,flux,tekton,knative}` | Slack / Teams / Discord + Custom Callback URL |
| **Generic / Multi-Source** | `/webhooks/generic` | `/webhooks/{azure-monitor,opsgenie,jira,argocd,gitlab,custom}` | Azure Monitor Common Alert Schema & custom JSON $\rightarrow$ Slack / Teams / Discord |

### Two-Way ChatOps (`channels` Addon: Slack, Microsoft Teams & Discord)
- **Endpoints:** `POST /channels/{slack,teams,discord}/{events,interactions,commands}`, `GET /channels/{status,health}`, `POST /channels/notify`.
- **Two-Stage Incident War-Rooms:** Posts an immediate parent incident card (`Status: Investigating`), replies in-thread with the structured 5-part RCA (attaching downloadable `.md` postmortems or Teams `<28 KB` Adaptive Card chunks), and updates the parent card in-place to `RCA Complete (in thread)` with triage duration and Root Cause Takeaway.
- **Interactive HITL & AutoQA Feedback:** Engineers approve/reject gated tool calls via buttons, 👍/👎 reactions, or thread replies, and click `Confirm RCA` / `Dispute Hypothesis` (locking the card in place and recording `feedback.helped` / `feedback.rejected` into `OperationalStore` via `IntelligenceAddon`).

---

## 10. Configuration Precedence, `config.toml`, `addons.json` & GitHub Action

### Configuration Files & Separation of Concerns
1. **CLI Flags & Runtime Env Vars** *(highest precedence)*
2. **Project Scope:** `<repo>/.talkops/.env`, `<repo>/.talkops/settings.local.json`, `<repo>/.talkops/settings.json`, `<repo>/.talkops/addons.json`
3. **User Global Scope:** `~/.talkops/.env` (secrets & provider keys, `0600`), `~/.talkops/config.toml` (personal CLI/TUI defaults), `~/.talkops/addons.json` (server addon defaults)

### Minimal `~/.talkops/config.toml` Example
```toml
[cloud]
provider = "aws"              # "aws" | "azure" | "gcp" | "k8s"
execution_mode = "elevated"   # "elevated" | "read_only"

[aws]
profile = "default"
region = "us-east-1"

[models]
default = "anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-5"

[agent_pool]
provider = "multi"
fast = "anthropic:claude-haiku-4-5"
standard = "anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-5"
powerful = "anthropic:claude-opus-4-6"

[security]
approval_mode = "smart"       # "manual" | "smart" | "auto" | "yolo"

[sandboxes]
default = "local"             # "local" | "modal" | "daytona" | "runloop" | "langsmith" | "agentcore" | "vercel"
sync_workspace = true
```

### GitHub Action for Pull Request Rubric Gates (`action.yml`)
```yaml
- name: Run TalkOps Rubric PR Check
  uses: talkops-ai/talkops@main
  with:
    talkops-api-key: ${{ secrets.TALKOPS_API_KEY }}
    anthropic-api-key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }} # or openai-api-key / google-api-key / model-api-key
    # model: "openai:Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct"
    # model-base-url: ${{ secrets.LLM_BASE_URL }}
    prompt: "Review the PR diff for Kubernetes & Terraform security, IAM least-privilege, and cloud cost regressions."
    rubric: "@examples/rubrics/k8s-security-rubric.md"
    read-only: "true"
    post-pr-comment: "true"
```
